parameters.description:
Send a notification to your own Chanify destination by posting a simple `msg` request to the UnitySVC gateway.

`msg-to-chanify` accepts an HTTP POST carrying the unified `msg` envelope (`title`, `body`, `type`, `format`). The gateway composes an Apprise `chanify://` URL from the credentials in your stored secrets and delivers via apprise.unitysvc.dev, so you run no messaging infrastructure of your own.

Four channels are available: the free `apprise` channel uses your own stored credentials; the `apprise-plus` channel binds extra per-enrollment destinations via enrollment parameters; the `gateway` channel transforms the envelope directly into a Chanify form-encoded payload and posts it to the Chanify sender API with no Apprise (free); and the `gateway-plus` channel does the same for extra per-enrollment destinations at $0.001 per message.
parameters.gateway_body_template: text={* _escape_json((_body.title or "")..(((_body.title or "")~="" and (_body.body or "")~="") and "\n" or "")..(_body.body or "")) *}
parameters.gateway_plus_price_description: $0.001 per message — extra per-enrollment Chanify destinations, direct
parameters.gateway_price_description: Free — direct to your Chanify sender token (no Apprise)

token_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's Chanify token
